summary: SUPERSEDE T109 by T112 — annotate T109.superseded_by = T112 in todo/config.yaml. SUPERSEDE is annotation-only; T109's contract, dependencies, recorded state, attempt, candidate/approval commits, evidence and review record are frozen at base 6c31778 / T109.md unchanged. No other task record, no other top-level config field, and no Intent/Spec text was touched.
rationale: T109 (DELIVERED, approved_commit 0ef2ce08...c79e4c83) is the historical product-run evidence pipeline. T112 (DELIVERED, approved_commit 40ad3a25...dc7e5cd6) declares 'replaces: [T109]' in todo/config.yaml (verified at config.yaml:1384-1386) and is T109's authoritative successor. The five direct consumers of T109 (T073, T084, T107, T108, T110) and the one indirect consumer (T087) were already repointed to T112 through the recorded CONTRACT amendments A0030 and A0032-A0036; A0039 just stripped T109 from their depends_on lists. The remaining indirect references in T088/T103/T096/T111 are owned by author responsibility for their own contracts and are out of A0040's scope. SUPERSEDE per todo/WORKFLOW.md is annotation-only: the smallest possible config.yaml edit adds a single 'superseded_by: T112' line to T109's record, which is precisely the change the finish-amendment drift check expects via _without_amendment_owned_config_fields. Historical approval evidence for T109 (c79e4c8.../review-004.json) is preserved by not editing T109's contract, lifecycle, claimed, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, or latest_review fields. The contract file todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T109.md is untouched.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE never edits docs/intent/. PROJECT_GOALS.md remains authoritative; this amendment does not change scope, intent revision, or any intent-tier claim. The active_task/active_phase/workflow_state/intent_revision top-level fields of todo/config.yaml are untouched (verified by 'git diff --stat' showing the single-line insertion in todo/config.yaml).
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE never edits docs/spec/. No spec revision or requirement text is altered by this amendment; the spec_revision top-level field of todo/config.yaml is unchanged. T109's behaviour has already migrated to T112 through the recorded CONTRACT amendments, so no spec path needs review.
impact_assessment.contracts: Not applicable as a changed-contract row. T109's contract at todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T109.md remains frozen at base 6c31778 and is not touched. Only the machine-readable annotation tasks.T109.superseded_by in todo/config.yaml is added (line 1327: 'superseded_by: T112'). No other task's contract text or contract file is edited; the self-impact guard is satisfied because T109 is the sole target and affected_existing_tasks is empty.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable. T109's depends_on and replaces arrays remain untouched. T109 is the predecessor, not a producer/consumer of the annotation change. T112 already lists T109 in its depends_on (config.yaml:1382) and replaces (config.yaml:1384-1386); those fields are not modified. The six prior consumer tasks (T073, T084, T087, T107, T108, T110) already point at T112 through earlier CONTRACT amendments and are not in this amendment's target set, so no dependency producer/consumer faces a new stale statement.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE does not implement or modify code. No file under docs/implement/, src/, or tests/ is touched. T109's implementation (c79e4c8...) and T112's implementation (40ad3a25...) remain their recorded approved commits; cutover is annotation-driven and did not produce two authoritative code paths because the earlier CONTRACT amendments already retired T109 from active use.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE changes no on-disk artefact, database row, audit log entry, raw-data segment, or feature-parquet output. The superseded_by field is purely machine-readable metadata; no schema migration, backfill, replay, or retention change is required.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE adds no command, scheduler entry, RPC endpoint, signing surface, or live-running operation. The annotation is dormant until a reader (review tooling, dependency resolution, or future contract authoring) consults tasks.T109.superseded_by; no live process is affected.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE introduces no permission change, no signing authority, no keystore surface, no secret material, and no network endpoint. V1 boundary (Phase 0-8 may not add signing; Phase 9 only contracted surfaces) is unaffected because this amendment is metadata-only and touches no execution or signer path.
impact_assessment.verification: Not applicable. SUPERSEDE has no task-specific verification to add; the finish-amendment drift check strips tasks.T*.superseded_by via _without_amendment_owned_config_fields, so the single-line annotation is permitted and required. Future Reviewers checking T109's successor relationship read superseded_by directly from tasks.T109 in todo/config.yaml. No test, oracle, or CI artefact is edited by this amendment.
